name: Ambience Healthcare
description: Ambience Healthcare (formerly Ambience AI) delivers enterprise-grade ambient AI with a broader clinical automation platform. Beyond ambient documentation (AutoScribe), Ambience offers pre-visit summaries, care gap identification, clinical decision support, and coding optimization (AutoCDI)—a fuller workflow suite than pure-scribe competitors. Backed by Kleiner Perkins, OpenAI Startup Fund, and Andreessen Horowitz, Ambience serves Sutter Health, UC San Diego Health, and The Permanente Medical Group. Pricing runs $233-417/provider/month base, with full platform costs reaching $4,000-5,000/provider/year. Not built for mental health; behavioral health divisions should verify specialty template support before deployment.
short_description: Enterprise AI platform with ambient scribe + pre-visit summaries + care gap identification. $233-417/mo. Not built for mental health practices.

faqs.q: How much does Ambience Healthcare cost in 2026?
faqs.a: AutoScribe base costs $233-267/provider/month ($2,800-3,200/year). The full AI suite with AutoCDI, AutoAVS, and AutoRefer runs $333-417/month ($4,000-5,000/year). Enterprise contracts with implementation fees. No self-serve or small practice pricing.

faqs.q: Is Ambience Healthcare good for psychiatry?
faqs.a: Ambience was not designed for behavioral health. The platform focuses on primary care, cardiology, and other medical specialties. Behavioral health divisions inside Ambience-contracted health systems should verify specialty template support before deployment. Solo psychiatrists should use Freed instead.

faqs.q: What's the difference between Ambience and Abridge?
faqs.a: Ambience offers a broader platform: ambient scribe plus pre-visit summaries, care gap identification, and coding optimization. Abridge focuses on ambient documentation with evidence-linked notes. Ambience may be slightly cheaper ($233-417/mo vs Abridge's $400-700/mo) but both are enterprise-only.

Ambience is backed by Kleiner Perkins, the OpenAI Startup Fund, General Catalyst, and Andreessen Horowitz. Total funding exceeds $100M. The OpenAI connection reflects Ambience's use of advanced language models for clinical AI.

faqs.q: Is Ambience worth it for mental health practices?
faqs.a: For most mental health practices, no. Ambience is enterprise-only with no small practice tier. At $233-417+/provider/month, it costs 5-10x more than therapy-specific tools. Mentalyc ($20-70/mo) and Upheal ($69/mo) are built for therapy. Freed ($39-119/mo) works for psychiatry.
